card.name: Words right before daytime or day
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as during, in, the, and right before 'day', 'daytime' or 'daylight', usually where day is set against night.

modes.label: Before daytime
modes.description: The word 'during' or 'the' or 'in' just before 'daytime' or 'daylight' in a day-versus-night contrast.
modes.example: Solar generation, on the other hand, takes place in<< the>> daytime.

modes.label: Before 'the day' in use instructions
modes.description: 'During' just before 'the day' when telling when something is used or removed.
modes.example: the tape may be used at night only and removed<< during>> the day.

modes.label: Night-and-day pairings
modes.description: A word in a night-focused phrase where a day counterpart is expected next.
modes.example: with temperatures around 80<<F>> and nighttime lows in the 60
